newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Star in option deal with JCI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Star in option deal with JCI.

text.p: Star Mining Corp NL said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with South African mining group JCI Ltd for JCI to acquire an option to subscribe for shares in Star's wholly owned subsidiary, Star Technology Systems Ltd.
Star said the exercise price of the option would be US$250 million.

Star Technology, Star Mining's main asset, holds a 34.88 percent interest in Russian closed joint stock company, Lenzoloto, which owns the mining and development rights within a 105,000 square kilometre area comprising the Lena gold fields in the east Siberia province of Irkutsk.
Star Mining said the area includes Sukhoi Log, Russia's largest undeveloped, proven gold deposit.
Under the terms of the memorandum, JCI would acquire, through its Star Technology stake, an economic interest of up to 30 percent in the Sukhoi Log project.
By 11.00 a.m. (2400 GMT), Star Mining shares were half a cent lower at 16 cents on turnover of 991,000 shares.
